title: Replanter Enchantment
description: My version of the Replanter Enchantment
body:
This pack adds my version of the Replanter enchantment to minecraft!

Here's how it works: Break a crop with your hoe enchanted with the enchantment.
If you have the corrosponding "seed" item for the broken crop in your inventory, it will be consumed and the crop will be repanted.

Has no effect in creative mode.
